12/1/91 - featured an opening statement from WWF President Jack Tunney in which he said an Undertaker / Hulk Hogan rematch for the WWF World Title and a match pitting Randy Savage against Jake Roberts would take place at the first possible date, this Tuesday in Texas which would air on pay-per-view; included comments from WWF World Champion the Undertaker & Paul Bearer regarding the title defense against Hogan; featured highlights of the ending and aftermath of the Ted Dibiase / Virgil match for the Million $ Title from the Survivor Series Showdown; included highlights of Sgt. Slaughter making the save for Jim Duggan the previous week on Wrestling Challenge; featured promos from Randy Savage and Jake Roberts regarding their match at Tuesday in Texas; included a promo from Davey Boy Smith regarding the latest issue of WBF Magazine; featured closing comments from Hulk Hogan regarding his title shot against the Undertaker at Tuesday in Texas:

12/8/91 - included a 'Special Report' segment in which WWF President Jack Tunney announced the WWF World Title was vacant as a result of what happened at Tuesday in Texas and that the winner of the upcoming 30-man Royal Rumble match would be declared the new champion; Tunney also said the two most recent champions, the Undertaker and Hulk Hogan, would be given an advantage in that the numbers they pick for the match would be between 20 and 30; featured a clip of the Bushwhackers playing the new Nintendo "WrestleMania Challenge" video game; included the first Royal Rumble report, with comments from Paul Bearer & the Undertaker:

12/15/91 - included a 'Special Report' segment with comments from Hulk Hogan about his participation in the Royal Rumble; featured footage of the Rockers playing the new WWF Nintendo Game Boy game against each other; included the announcement Davey Boy Smith, the Berzerker, IRS, Virgil, the Warlord, Kerry Von Erich, Ric Flair, and Randy Savage would be part of the 30-man Royal Rumble match; featured highlights of the Savage / Roberts match from Tuesday in Texas:

12/22/91 - included Gene Okerlund conducting a podium interview with the Mountie & Jimmy Hart discussing WWF IC Champion Bret Hart receiving the WWF Wrestler of the Year Award the previous week on WWF Superstars, with the Mountie saying he himself was the 'Excellence of Electrocution'; featured a 'Special Report' segment in which the Nasty Boys, Jim Duggan, Tito Santana, and Jake Roberts were announced to compete in the Royal Rumble; it was mentioned during the segment there was a rumor Sid Justice could be part of the match as well; a Royal Rumble report later in the show featured the announcement Ted Dibiase, Skinner, and Repo Man would be part of the 30-man Royal Rumble as well:
